hooks.command: VENV="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA}/venv"; REQ="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/requirements.txt"; STAMP="${VENV}/.requirements.txt"; if [ -f "$STAMP" ] && diff -q "$REQ" "$STAMP" > /dev/null 2>&1; then exit 0; fi; mkdir -p "$(dirname "$VENV")" 2>&1; if command -v uv > /dev/null 2>&1; then uv venv "$VENV" --quiet && VIRTUAL_ENV="$VENV" uv pip install --quiet -r "$REQ"; else python -m venv "$VENV" || python3 -m venv "$VENV"; PIP="$VENV/Scripts/pip.exe"; [ -f "$PIP" ] || PIP="$VENV/bin/pip"; "$PIP" install -q -r "$REQ"; fi; MLLOG="$VENV/bin/mllog"; [ -f "$MLLOG" ] || MLLOG="$VENV/Scripts/mllog.exe"; if [ -f "$MLLOG" ] && "$MLLOG" --version > /dev/null 2>&1; then cp "$REQ" "$STAMP"; else echo "mllog: bootstrap failed — mllog --version did not exit 0" >&2; rm -f "$STAMP"; fi; exit 0

VENV="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA}/venv"; MLLOG="$VENV/bin/mllog"; [ -f "$MLLOG" ] || MLLOG="$VENV/Scripts/mllog.exe"; [ -f "$MLLOG" ] || exit 0; PYEXE="$(dirname "$MLLOG")/python"; [ -f "$PYEXE" ] || PYEXE="$(dirname "$MLLOG")/python.exe"; [ -f "$PYEXE" ] || PYEXE=python3; INPUT=$(cat); SESSION=$(echo "$INPUT" | "$PYEXE" -c "import sys,json; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print(d.get('transcriptPath') or d.get('transcript_path',''))" 2>/dev/null || true); ARGS=(capture --status ok --auto); [ -n "$SESSION" ] && [ -f "$SESSION" ] && ARGS+=(--session-path "$SESSION"); "$MLLOG" "${ARGS[@]}"; exit 0
